description: Use when a Makefile target and its coverage manifest have drifted apart — the `bats` check failing with a `diff` between the Makefile target list and the target column of `tests/bats/make-target-coverage.tsv`, a manifest row whose `evidence` file does not exist or never names the target as a whole token, a row left behind by a renamed or deleted target, or a linter added to the `lint` aggregate but missing from `CI_LINT_TARGETS`.
